profile.headline: Software Developer at TCS Education System
profile.summary: 4+ years of experience working with .Net/C# , SQL Server for Web/Windows applications

positions.title: .Net Developer
positions.description:
•	Understand the business requirements from senior business analyst
•	Responsible for understanding business requirement for reports and convert into functional aspect and publish to CRM Dynamics website
•	Program complicated SQL queries and design reports (SSRS) using the queries
•	Write c# code using CRM Dynamics/.Net 4.0 to manipulate SFA data
•	Design user interface for CRM Dynamics. Involved in creating and manipulating entity forms. Also involved in creating entity and fields
•	Create CRM Dynamics solution, create/update entity, form, fields or views in the solution, export the solution and import in another environment to affect the change
•	Work with Development, Certification, POC and Production environment to affect the change
•	Import excel data or export data to excel for Dynamics data manipulation

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
•	Gather the requirements from the Senior Software Engineer, BRD and converting it to      functional aspects.
•	Deliver new enhancements to existing applications as per need
•	Design UI using WinForm
•	Develop user controls for consistent look and feel of overall system
•	Implement business logic using C# .net 2.0/3.5
•	Implement SOA architecture – Work with WebService, Stored Procedures, Tables
•	Click once deployment
•	Unit Testing

positions.title: Junior .Net Developer
positions.description:
•	Gather the requirements from the Senior Software Engineer and the Project Manager.
•       Convert gathered requirements to functional aspects and implement the changes requested
•	Design user interface and develop classes, interfaces, business logic and components in C#
•	Create Stored Procedure,Views,Indexes;code behind program in C# for the 3 layered Archite.
•	Create ASP.NET (ASPX) pages, User Controls (ASCX)
•	Design and implement data access layer using ADO.NET to connect and manipulate db info.
•	Implement C# language features such as Generics, Delegates, ASP.NET AJAX Controls
•	Perform client and server validations using Validation Controls
•	Develop Custom User Controls
•	Develop Reusable Components in C#

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop Web Forms, Classes, Interfaces, Business Logic and components
•	Use ADO.NET for data interaction between web pages and database
•	Create stored procedures to retrieve relevant data
•	Document the technical details
•	Use various controls like data controls to populate data in ASP.NET
•	Develop code behind classes
•	Use validation server controls to validate data

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description:
•	Involve in object oriented programming to implement windows application using VB.NET and ORACLE
•	Involve in adding new enhancements, product maintenance, trouble shooting and bug fixing
•	Involve in migrating the application to VB
•	Develop web Forms in ASP.NET and windows forms using VB.Net
•	Use validation controls such as Range, RequiredField, Compare, RegularExpression & Custom Validator to validate data
